replicaCount.description: Number of replicas. Values greater than 1 require a PostgreSQL connection string via config.databaseUrl or existingSecret. Enforced at chart render time.

tag.description: Container image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

imagePullSecrets.description: List of image pull secret references.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name component of generated resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full generated resource name.

create.description: Whether to create a dedicated ServiceAccount.

annotations.description: Annotations to apply to the ServiceAccount.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Defaults to the fullname when empty and create=true.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to apply to the Pod.

podLabels.description: Extra labels to apply to the Pod.

port.description: Service port for the HTTP listener.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the ATC container.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for pod scheduling. When non-empty, fully overrides the chart's podAntiAffinity injection (see podAntiAffinity).

type.description: Anti-affinity mode. 'soft' (default) preferred with weight 100, 'hard' required, 'off' omits the chart-injected rule. Overridden by a non-empty affinity value.

httpAddr.description: Address and port the HTTP listener binds to (ATC_HTTP_ADDR).

metricsAddr.description: Address and port the metrics listener binds to (ATC_METRICS_ADDR).

databaseUrl.description: Database connection URL (ATC_DATABASE_URL). See values.yaml for the two storage modes.

databaseListenerUrl.description: Listener database connection URL (ATC_DATABASE_LISTENER_URL). When empty, the listener falls back to ATC_DATABASE_URL. Set when the main pool runs through transaction-mode PgBouncer.

logFilter.description: Tracing filter string in RUST_LOG syntax (ATC_LOG_FILTER).

logFormat.description: Log output format: 'pretty', 'json', or null to let the binary decide by build type (ATC_LOG_FORMAT).

name.description: Name of an existing Secret containing the database URL.

databaseUrlKey.description: Key inside the Secret whose value is the database URL.

databaseListenerUrlKey.description: Key inside the Secret whose value is the listener database URL. When empty, the listener falls back to ATC_DATABASE_URL.

enabled.description: Whether to expose the metrics port on the Service.
Set to true to create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor.

additionalLabels.description: Extra labels added to the ServiceMonitor metadata.

enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource.

annotations.description: Annotations to apply to the Ingress.

enabled.description: Whether to create a Gateway API HTTPRoute resource.

parentRefs.description: parentRefs pointing at the Gateway(s) that should serve this HTTPRoute.

rules.description: Custom HTTPRoute rules. Empty generates a default catch-all rule.

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Seconds the preStop hook sleeps before SIGTERM. 0 disables the hook.

enabled.description: Whether to render a PodDisruptionBudget for the ATC Deployment.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number (integer) or percentage string (e.g. '50%') of pods that must remain available during voluntary disruptions. Mutually exclusive with maxUnavailable; the chart fails template rendering when both are set.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number (integer) or percentage string (e.g. '50%') of pods that may be unavailable during voluntary disruptions. Mutually exclusive with minAvailable; the chart fails template rendering when both are set.

enabled.description: Whether to render the NetworkPolicy resource.

ingress.description: Ingress rules. Each item is a networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicyIngressRule, passed through verbatim.

egress.description: Egress rules. Each item is a networking.k8s.io/v1 NetworkPolicyEgressRule, passed through verbatim.

enabled.description: Whether to render a HorizontalPodAutoscaler. When true, the Deployment's spec.replicas field is dropped.

minReplicas.description: Minimum replicas the HPA may scale down to.

maxReplicas.description: Maximum replicas the HPA may scale up to. When > 1, requires an external Postgres connection string.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilization (percentage of requested CPU). When null, the CPU metric is omitted; when set, requires resources.requests.cpu.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilization (percentage of requested memory). When null, the memory metric is omitted.

enabled.description: Whether to include the helm test hook Pod.
